summary: flasq 0.1.2 install-time dropper fetches and executes opaque Linux binary from personal GitHub release
details: setup.py overrides the install command with a LinuxInstall class that decodes a base64-encoded payload and runs it via exec(compile(...)) at install time. When run on Linux, the decoded hook downloads an opaque binary from https://github.com/totti2188/8gp1Q7iZD3h4VW/releases/download/v1.3A/something, stages it under /tmp, chmods it 0755, and launches it detached via subprocess.Popen. There is no hash or signature verification, the source is a personal GitHub account unrelated to the package's declared purpose, and the fetch-and-execute logic is hidden behind base64 obfuscation. Installing the sdist causes attacker-controlled native code to run on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
